What is Bondi

We don't do noise.
We do meaning.
Connection through doing.

Bondi is a members-only community app for the active, creative, and culturally in-the-know. Post what you want to do, choose who joins, and meet people worth knowing - or just browse and attend what others are hosting. Either way, you're in the right room.

Social barriers are lower during an activity. Most people default to bars. Bondi defaults to sports, creative outlets, and shared interests. No endless swiping, no awkward mixers or happy hours, no networking seminars where you collect business cards and forget everyone's name. Just real experiences, with the right people, doing something you actually love.
